Vaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES)
cohort: 11 patients who underwent a vNOTES hysterectomy after prior vNOTES adnexectomy or cystectomy
finding: This case series found that vNOTES hysterectomy after prior vNOTES adnexal surgery was successfully performed in all 11 patients.
